# Cognexa Technologies

> Cognexa Technologies provides enterprise cybersecurity, AI automation, and knowledge intelligence platforms — Surakshitam, Aurobit, and Vidya AI — to mid-to-large businesses across India.

Contact: +91 98989 31509, sales@cognexa.in. Based in India, serving India and global clients.

## Products

- [Surakshitam](https://cognexa.in/products/surakshitam/): Enterprise cybersecurity suite — managed firewall (Kavach), vulnerability scanning (Durg), penetration testing (Shastra), web application firewall, VPN, captive portal, and network monitoring. Also at [surakshitam.com](https://surakshitam.com).
- [Aurobit](https://cognexa.in/products/aurobit/): AI operations and automation platform for runbook automation, incident management, and AIOps analytics.
- [Vidya AI](https://cognexa.in/products/vidya-ai/): Private knowledge intelligence platform that makes enterprise policies and SOPs accessible through natural language, deployed on-premise.
